purpose: Measure the actual training observer cost and a higher state-display rate before the next gait repair. Diagnostic weights are excluded from model selection.
source_policy: Restore identical actor, critic, Adam, normalization, adaptive rate and curriculum counter in fresh processes. Preserve rewards, physics, dependencies and video. Between cases only process-local graphics selection and the declared observer cap change. Compare driver at 4 Hz, then display cap within D3D12.
measurement_policy: Use all final 20 complete updates, no spike removal. Initial video is wholly in warmup. Log per-update wall/collection/learning and observer totals, real state-sample count and simulation-step advance. Abort if viewer closes; never compare a run that silently lost its display. Whole-process time is separate. No training-state perturbation or extra environment steps.

selection_rule.scope: Project decision criteria for this same-host screen, not a population speedup claim or gait acceptance; 15 Hz cap is not a guarantee of 15 new states per second.
